title: Find the 1 V ramp
story: A capacitance meter pushes a steady 1 mA into the part under test and expects the voltage to climb about 1 V every millisecond, so that it reads close to 1 V at 1 ms and close to 2 V at 2 ms. Which capacitor makes the ramp right?
hints: A steady current moves charge Q = I x t: in 1 ms, 1 mA moves 1 uC.
The voltage is V = Q / C. Which C turns 1 uC into 1 V?
A capacitor ten times bigger makes the ramp ten times slower.
